versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.3

- Added a new usage scenario for listing and filtering recent Cainiao parcel statuses (e.g., filter by origin or arrival at pickup station).
- Updated documentation: included an example for checking all parcels in Cainiao Guoguo within the last week and identifying those awaiting pickup from specific origins.
- No changes to local data persistence or privacy controls.
- README.md added.

- Major update: removed all runtime code; the skill now contains only documentation (SKILL.md).
- Updated and expanded usage scenarios in SKILL.md for tracking, station lookup, and shipping estimates.
- Enhanced documentation for privacy controls, local persistence, and operational workflow.
- Added metadata fields (version, tags) to SKILL.md.
- Removed skill code and dependency files (cainiao.py, requirements.txt, security.py).
No user-facing changes detected in this version.
